newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Heatwave blamed for Adelaide blackout.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Heatwave blamed for Adelaide blackout.

text.p: About one-third of Adelaide's central business district suffered a major power failure on Tuesday as South Australia's continuing heatwave pushed up electricity demand, the Electricity Trust (ETSA) said.
ETSA spokeswoman Sue Vincent told Reuters the blackout, which lasted for up to three hours in some parts of the city, followed overloading of eastern city transformers.
Vincent said the State's electricity consumption on Tuesday was expected to approach or exceed the previous record 2286 megawatt average half hour reading on February 4.
South Australians have sweltered under 40 degree celsius heat this week, with temperatures expected to remain in the mid to high 30s for the remainder of the week.
